children: Anthropic shares made their trading debut at $111.50 each, up about 34% from the IPO price of $83 a share.

The maker of the Claude chatbot raised $81 billion in the largest IPO of all time and became the first standalone artificial-intelligence lab to be publicly traded. The shares are listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
